user.title: Codex Assist
user.description: Sign in with your ChatGPT/Codex account first. You will choose a chat model from your account’s model list after signing in.

device.title: Sign in with Codex

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in with Codex again
reauth_confirm.description: Codex Assist needs a fresh ChatGPT/Codex sign-in. Continue to request a new device code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Codex Assist
reconfigure.description: Sign in again with your ChatGPT/Codex account. Your conversation agents and AI Task settings will stay unchanged.

model.title: Choose a chat model
model.description: {model_status} Select the model for the first conversation agent and the AI Task entity. You can add more conversation agents with their own models later. Availability and feature support can vary by account.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Codex Assist was reconfigured and signed in again.

error.authorization_pending: That code has not been approved yet. Finish signing in in your browser, wait a few seconds, then continue again.
error.device_code_auth_failed: Codex sign-in failed. Restart setup and try again.
error.device_code_request_failed: Could not request a Codex device code. Check network access from Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_model: Choose a model from the displayed list.
error.no_models: Your account returned no visible models. Try again later or restart setup with another account.

init.title: Conversation agent
init.description:
{model_status}

Each conversation agent appears as its own entity you can pick in an Assist pipeline. Advanced settings stay collapsed until you need them. Device control still follows Home Assistant’s Assist exposed-entity settings.

data_description.name: Shown as the agent’s device and Assist pipeline choice.

data_description.model: The model this conversation agent uses.
data_description.text_verbosity: How concise or detailed normal text and voice responses should be.
data_description.web_search: Allow the model to search the web for current information. Search is off by default.

data_description.prompt: Standing instructions for this conversation agent.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much reasoning supported models should use before answering.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Codex Assist must be loaded before you can change this. Enable or reload the integration, then try again.

error.invalid_model: Choose a listed model or keep your saved model.
error.no_models: Your account returned no visible models. Try again later.

init.title: AI Task
init.description:
{model_status}

Settings for Home Assistant AI Task data and image generation. Advanced and image-generation defaults stay collapsed until you need them.

data_description.name: Shown as the AI Task entity’s device name.

data_description.model: The model used for AI Task requests.
data_description.text_verbosity: How concise or detailed AI Task text results should be.
data_description.web_search: Allow the model to search the web for unstructured AI Task results. Search is off by default and is never used for structured results.

data_description.reasoning_effort: How much reasoning supported models should use before answering.

data_description.image_model: Default quality for images created through Home Assistant AI Task.
data_description.image_size: Default shape and resolution for generated images.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Codex Assist must be loaded before you can change this. Enable or reload the integration, then try again.

error.invalid_model: Choose a listed model or keep your saved model.
error.no_models: Your account returned no visible models. Try again later.
